diagnosis: Each cut to the x4 plateau has lowered the loss (0.094 to 0.068), yet the ten worst failures are still uniform over-predictions of 0.23-0.27, all at |x4| between 1.47 and 2.65, where the x4 term contributes about +0.18 to +0.26. Eight of the ten rows also have positive x1 (up to +2.49), so the base prediction is already raised and the extra x4 lift overshoots. The x2*x5 products here are mostly small or moderately negative and are not the main driver, so the remaining error is mainly the x4 lift being too large at high |x4|.
suggested_change: Reduce the x4 amplitude again and make it saturate earlier, keeping it mean-centred and keeping the interaction: clip(0.4 * (1.0 - exp(-x4**2)) - 0.17 + 0.3 * tanh(0.5 * x2 * x5), -0.6, 0.6). This keeps the -0.17 penalty near x4 = 0 but caps the large-|x4| lift at about +0.23 instead of up to +0.26-0.33, and flattens the growth beyond |x4| of about 1.5, where the over-predictions concentrate.
